target_customer: Quality teams at aerospace, defense and medical manufacturers and their suppliers (customer logos on its site include Protolabs, Sanmina, Precision Castparts and Boom Supersonic)
problem: First Article Inspection Reports under AS9102 are slow manual paperwork. GroundControl extracts characteristics from drawings and automates the reports, supplier submissions and purchase order review.
business_model: B2B SaaS for quality teams; pricing not found
product_category: Quality software for regulated manufacturing (AS9102 FAIR automation)

founders.name: Mehul Shah
prior_employers: Family PCB manufacturing business (built software for it)
founders.background_notes: YC page says eight years of software work for the family business, launch post says the last decade.

founders.name: Matthew Noseworthy
education: Electrical and computer engineering undergraduate (school not named)

founders.name: Nick Warren
previous_startups: InspectAR (co-founded with Matthew, acquired by Cadence)
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post, not given a profile on the YC page.

competitors.name: Discus
competitors.what: FAI creation software consolidating requirements and syncing drawings with inspection sheets

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting characteristics from engineering drawings and generating compliant reports needs document AI and domain rules. The founders' prior InspectAR work in the quality domain helped.

defensibility.rationale: The site states ITAR registration, Canada's Controlled Goods Program and FedRAMP Moderate Equivalency, which raises the bar for defense customers. Established vendors such as 1factory and Ideagen already offered AS9102 tooling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determined. Search results show incumbent FAI vendors marketing AI features, with undated pages.

market_need_then: AS9102 reports are required in aerospace supply chains and the company reports 70+ facilities as customers and nearly 1,000 reports per month on its YC page, which shows demand. Spend figures were not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses rungroundcontrol.com, redirecting to gndctl.com, so the exact groundcontrol.com belongs to a different satellite IoT company.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared by several unrelated companies, including a satellite IoT firm and QGroundControl, and the company needed a prefixed domain and a short alias. No brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: GroundControl is an active Spring 2025 company whose founders came from a PCB manufacturer and from InspectAR, which Cadence acquired, giving real domain access. Its site claims hundreds of quality teams and government-cloud readiness. Funding is not verified, and the generic name collides with several other companies, but no failure or exit has been reported.
notes: Funding: Seedtable lists $2.0M in June 2025 and other profiles list $3M or $5M total with 8VC, but only aggregators and no press release were found, so no round is recorded. Customer counts conflict between the YC page (70+ facilities) and the site (hundreds of teams) and are dated differently. The Discus webinar is dated January 2025. brand_effect hurt rests on the domain situation only. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: Seedtable's 2.0M seed of June 2025 is recorded and rests on that database alone. Other profiles say 3M total; the gap is unresolved. The company about page lists 8VC, Deep Acre, Y Combinator and Shah Capital Ventures as backers, but no dated round for them was found.
